title: Committee of Supply – Head O (Ministry of Health)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head O (Ministry of Health)

sections.label: Budget cut motion, doctor declaration
sections.summary: The speaker moves to reduce Head O of the Estimates by $100 and declares being a medical doctor in a public hospital.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head O of the Estimates be reduced by $100".

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: I declare that I am a medical doctor in a public hospital.

sections.label: Older flats with high steps
sections.summary: Some stay in older flats with doorway steps too high for HDB's Enhancement for Active Seniors programme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Some stay in older flats with multiple steps at the doorway, flats where the steps are too high for the usual Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE) programme organised by HDB.

sections.label: Old lady's clinic visits
sections.summary: An old lady told the speaker she has 10 clinic visits in the next three months.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: One old lady told me she has 10 clinic visits in the upcoming, next three months.

sections.label: Son quit job to care
sections.summary: Her 50-year old son quit his job to look after her.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Her 50-year old son quit his job to look after her.

sections.label: MOH studies on healthcare design
sections.summary: The speaker asks the Ministry whether MOH has done recent studies on healthcare facilities design, healthcare IT and patient experience.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: And if so why, and how can we make it better?

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: So, I ask the Ministry, has MOH done any recent studies on the design of healthcare facilities, healthcare IT and the patient experience?

sections.label: Nurses and allied health pay
sections.summary: The speaker had called on MOH to pay nurses and allied health workers more, and welcomes announced better salaries for nursing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Last year during the debate on the President's Address, I called upon MOH to look at paying our nurses and allied health workers more and I am glad the Finance Minister has announced better salaries for our sisters and brothers in nursing.

sections.label: Outsourcing hospital cleaners and attendants
sections.summary: The passage states that more cleaners and healthcare attendants are outsourced and that the rationale for outsourcing hospital cleaners and attendants is not compelling.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Today, a growing number of cleaners and healthcare attendants have been outsourced.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: But, Sir, the rationale for outsourcing hospital cleaners and hospital attendants is not compelling.

sections.label: Hospital cleaners as healthcare team
sections.summary: It argues hospital cleaners and attendants should be part of the healthcare team, that direct hiring helps hospitals create jobs, and asks the Ministry to reconsider outsourcing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Because, Sir, when we are fighting on the COVID-19 frontline, we are all in this together.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: We should think about hospital cleaners, our hospital attendants as part of the whole healthcare team and not as a service to be outsourced.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Furthermore, Sir, direct hiring also makes it easier for hospitals to create additional jobs and job opportunities to hire directly from the community nearby.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: We should look at ways for hospitals to generate employment for residents living nearby as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: I call upon the Ministry to consider this outsourcing issue as one of the issues which COVID-19 is forcing societies around the world to re-think.

sections.label: Vaccination percentage statistics
sections.summary: It asks for the latest statistics on the percentage of eligible recipients vaccinated since the first roll-out in December.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Since the first vaccination roll-out in December, what are the latest statistics pertaining to the percentage of eligible recipients who are vaccinated?

sections.label: Interim post-mortem report review
sections.summary: It asks whether MOH will work with the multi-ministerial task force to conduct a review and release an interim post-mortem report.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Will MOH work with the multi-ministerial task force to conduct a review and release an interim post-mortem report?

sections.label: Delay in building facilities
sections.summary: It asks what contingency plan MOH has to deal with the delay in building hospitals, polyclinics and nursing homes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: What contingency plan does MOH have to deal with the delay in building hospitals, polyclinics and nursing homes?

sections.label: Community Care Apartments and life expectancy
sections.summary: It asks if MOH and MND will offer more oversubscribed Community Care Apartments, and notes life expectancy and illness findings for residents with below Secondary education.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Many are interested in Singapore’s first Community Care Apartments in Bukit Batok, which are affordable housing with senior-friendly features.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: I understand that it is 4.2 times oversubscribed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Since the take-up rate is so strong, will MOH and MND consider offering more of such flats at the next quarter or so?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, Sir, from a recent reply to my Parliamentary Question, we now know that residents aged 25 years old with below Secondary education have a life expectancy 5.8 years lower than that with those with post-Secondary education.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: We also learnt that people with below Secondary education have a greater likelihood of chronic illnesses like diabetes and high cholesterol.

sections.label: Healthy Living Passports Scheme pilot
sections.summary: HPB piloted the Healthy Living Passports Scheme in mid-2020 and aims to reach 15,000 lower income residents over three years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Once we have more data, we must act decisively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I note that HPB piloted the Healthy Living Passports Scheme in mid-2020 and aim to reach 15,000 lower income residents over three years.

sections.label: MOH services expenditure and inflation
sections.summary: MOH's services expenditures of about $11 billion, about 2.2% of GDP, must be judged with more information, amid 10% medical inflation in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Only with this information can we make an informed judgement whether MOH’s services expenditures of about $11 billion which represents about 2.2% of our GDP, is enough or not.

sentences.speaker: Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Singapore has one of the best healthcare systems in the world but it does not come cheap.

sentences.speaker: Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: This is evident from the effectiveness of our COVID-19 response and is further reinforced by the fact that Singaporeans enjoy one of the highest life expectancies in the world – that is 83.8 years for 2021.

sentences.speaker: Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: In 2018, medical inflation was at 10%,10 times more than the general inflation rate in Singapore.

sections.label: Healthcare costs for lowest income group
sections.summary: The lowest 20% income bracket saw healthcare costs form the largest portion, 7.8% of their household expenses.

sentences.speaker: Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The actual increase differs slightly across different income groups, and it is somewhat concerning that the below income group, the lowest 20% bracket saw their healthcare costs forming the largest portion which is 7.8% of their household expenses.

sections.label: Annual limits seen as inadequate
sections.summary: Many feel the annual limits of $200 or $500 are inadequate for their needs given current healthcare costs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Many feel that the annual limits of $200 or $500 are inadequate for their needs, given current healthcare costs.

sections.label: MediSave chronic conditions and limits
sections.summary: MOH is asked to allow MediSave withdrawals for all chronic conditions and remove annual withdrawal limits for patients over 60 with at least $5,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can MOH allow MediSave withdrawals for the treatment of all chronic conditions, not just those under the Chronic Disease Management Programme list to ensure that no one is excluded just because they suffer from a less common chronic condition?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And can MOH remove annual withdrawal limits on the use of MediSave of patients over 60 years old, who have a balance of at least $5,000 in their MediSave accounts?

sections.label: MediShield Life premiums and claims
sections.summary: Between 2016 and 2019, $7.5 billion in MediShield Life premiums were collected, $3.5 billion in claims paid, and $3 billion set aside for rebates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: Between 2016 and 2019, $7.5 billion in premiums for MediShield Life were collected and $3.5 billion in claims were paid out, while a further $3 billion was set aside for future premium rebates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: Many Singaporeans are concerned about the impending premium hikes of up to 35% to MediShield Life.

sections.label: Postponing increased premiums
sections.summary: A question asks whether MOH can consider postponing the increased premiums until the economy recovers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: Can MOH consider postponing the increased premiums until our economy recovers?

sections.label: Portability of IPs
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Minister will ensure IPs are fully portable by requiring providers to allow switching without additional conditions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa
sentences.text: Theoretically, insurers can entice younger people with much lower premiums and later hike the premiums significantly when they are older and unable to switch insurers due to their pre-existing conditions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa
sentences.text: Will the Minister consider ensuring that IPs are fully portable by making it a condition for IP providers to allow policy holders to switch providers without imposing additional conditions?

sections.label: Five key healthcare factors
sections.summary: The speaker lists five key factors: technology advances, healthcare facilities costs, doctors' fees, patient health-seeking behaviour and insurers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I see a need for everyone to be part of the solution.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I list five key factors: (a) advances in technology leading to better quality of care; (b) healthcare facilities costs, (c) doctors' fees; (d) patient health-seeking behaviour; and (e) insurers.

sections.label: SMA fees and benchmarks
sections.summary: SMA had a fee guideline since 1987, removed in 2007 as anti-competitive, and MOH announced fee benchmarks in end 2017.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Historically, SMA had a guideline of fees since 1987, which had to be removed in 2007, as it was deemed anti-competitive.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: MOH announced in end 2017 that fee benchmarks will be implemented.

sections.label: IPs bought by residents
sections.summary: Close to 70% of Singapore Residents buy IPs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Close to 70% of Singapore Residents buy IPs.

sections.label: IP provider specialist payments
sections.summary: A question asks how the IP provider pays specialists and whether it follows MOH fee benchmarks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Six, how does the IP provider pay specialists; does it follow MOH fee benchmarks?

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I realised that other than the first two questions, information was difficult or impossible to obtain for me to make an informed decision on which IP to purchase.

sections.label: Private hospital market share and IPs
sections.summary: Private hospitals and A and B1 class beds hold an estimated 30% to 35% market share, while nearly 70% of Singapore Residents buy an IP.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The combined market share of private hospitals and A class and B1 class beds in Restructured Hospitals is estimated to be in the range of 30% to 35%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Yet the proportion of Singapore Residents buying an IP is nearing 70%.

sections.label: Subsidies, insurers and waiting times
sections.summary: Government subsidies indirectly subsidise insurers' IP businesses, deprive patients-in-need of subsidies, and lengthen waiting times for subsidised services in restructured hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The consumption of these Government subsidies are indirectly subsidising the insurers' IP businesses and depriving patients-in-need of more subsidies, since MOH's budget is a finite thing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Another important corollary of this unusual phenomenon is that it further lengthens the waiting times for subsidised services in restructured hospitals.

sections.label: Healthcare costs, transparency and MediSave limits
sections.summary: Medical professional bodies are ready to help solve escalating healthcare costs, and the speaker calls for transparency and accountability of insurance companies and agents, noting MediSave limits have not been reviewed in over seven years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In summary, escalating healthcare costs is a complex problem, and the medical professional bodies are ready to be part of the solution through honest, open discussion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I call for increased transparency and accountability of insurance companies and their agents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Recently, many couples have called for an increase in these limits to better meet IVF costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: MOH has said, "Couples who find themselves unable to cope with unexpectedly large bills, for instance, as a result of complications, even after co-funding, may appeal to use MediSave beyond the current limits" on a case-by-case basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It has been over seven years since we reviewed these withdrawal limits.

sections.label: Couples' monthly IVF spending
sections.summary: Couples the speaker spoke to spend around $500 to $1,000 a month on top of already mounting IVF costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Couples I have spoken to end up spending around $500 to $1,000 a month, on top of already mounting IVF costs.

sections.label: Gestational diabetes and children's risks
sections.summary: One in five mothers-to-be develop gestational diabetes, raising their children's risk of obesity, Type 2 diabetes, heart disease and neurodevelopmental disorder, and mothers' mental well-being also affects children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling
sentences.text: The study found that one in five mothers-to-be develop gestational diabetes and this heightened the risk of their children developing obesity Type 2 diabetes, heart disease and even neurodevelopmental disorder later in their lives.

sentences.speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling
sentences.text: Mental well-being of mothers-to-be will also affect children, who are likely to develop neuro-developmental disorders such as anxiety, depression or disruptive behaviour disorders.

sections.label: COVID-19 vaccination progress
sections.summary: As of 4 March, more than 350,000 Singapore Residents received a first dose, 215,000 a second dose, and over 40,000 seniors aged 70 and above a first dose.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: As of 4 March, more than 350,000 Singapore Residents have received their first dose, including some 80% of our healthcare workforce, and 215,000 have received their second doses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Over 40,000 seniors aged 70 and above have received their first dose.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will soon begin the vaccination of seniors aged 60 and above.

sections.label: Primary care and community nursing
sections.summary: Singapore will build 12 new polyclinics, reaching 32 by 2030, and has expanded Community Nursing teams to 29 regions with 185 posts since September 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will continue to anchor care in the community by strengthening primary care.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will be building 12 new polyclinics, bringing the total to 32 by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We are also expanding community care, especially for our seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We have expanded the Community Nursing teams to cover 29 regions across Singapore since September 2020, with a total of 185 Community Nursing Posts to make care more accessible to our seniors.

sections.label: Health agency savings and expenditure
sections.summary: The Agency for Care Effectiveness saved $300 million since 2016, ALPS saved about $180 million in two years, and government's share of National Health Expenditure rose from 40% in 2013 to 46% in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: As Minister Lawrence Wong mentioned, the Agency for Care Effectiveness has enabled us to save $300 million since 2016 and benefited over 375,000 patients.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The Agency for Logistics Procurement and Supply, or ALPS for short, has also achieved cost savings of about $180 million in two years by driving economies of scale through group procurement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The Government continues to bear a significant and growing share of the National Health Expenditure, from 40% in 2013 to 46% in 2018.

sections.label: Subsidies for lowest income quintile
sections.summary: The lowest income quintile received 37% of total subsidies in 2018, the highest share, and per-household subsidies rose over 70% from 2013 to 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: In fact, the lowest income quintile’s share of total subsidies was 37% in 2018, the highest across all income quintiles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Further, the amount of subsidies received per household for the lowest income quintile has increased by over 70% from 2013 to 2018.

sections.label: Longitudinal life-course care planning
sections.summary: Singapore will study a longitudinal system of care with a life-course approach, and the National Healthcare Group developed a River of Life framework while SingHealth trials prescribing social programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: As we plan for our future health system, we will study how we can develop a longitudinal system of care services and programmes, to journey with you and design programmes with a life-course approach, taking care of each Singaporean from birth and throughout their life.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The National Healthcare Group has, in fact, developed a River of Life framework to test this approach.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: SingHealth, for example, has started trials to prescribe not just drugs but also social programmes, such as diet, exercise and social activities.

sections.label: Supporting the healthcare team
sections.summary: The dedicated healthcare team will continue to receive better progression, more training opportunities, and greater recognition of their work and risks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We are blessed with a very dedicated, driven and professional team.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: They are our most precious resource, and we will continue to provide them with better progression, more training opportunities, and greater recognition of the work and risks they undertake.

sections.label: Progress of seniors' ageing measures
sections.summary: The passage asks about the progress of MOH measures announced last year to help seniors age in place, especially Eldercare Centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: Last year, MOH announced various measures to better support seniors to age in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: What is the progress of these measures, especially on the Eldercare Centres?

sections.label: Review of once-in-a-lifetime eligibility
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry will review the policy of once-in-a-lifetime eligibility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: Will the Ministry review the policy of the once-in-a-lifetime eligibility?

sections.label: SMF coverage for non-HDB safety features
sections.summary: The passage says this runs contrary to ageing-in-place policies and suggests SMF extend coverage to elderly-friendly safety features in non-HDB estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: This runs contrary to our policies of encouraging ageing in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: I would also like to suggest that SMF extends its coverage to elderly-friendly safety features in non-HDB estates, such as ramps and grab bars, especially for the lower value private units.

sections.label: Review of Caregiver Support Action Plan
sections.summary: The passage states caregivers faced anxiety, loneliness and depression, and that it is timely to review the 2019 Caregiver Support Action Plan.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: Some of them had to cope with heightened feelings of anxiety, loneliness and depression.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: And with foreign domestic help being more costly and hard to come by in the midst of the pandemic, it is timely to review the Caregiver Support Action Plan that was launched in 2019.

sections.label: Expanding home-based respite care support
sections.summary: The passage describes respite care duration and asks MOH to consider expanding support for caregivers needing home-based short-term respite care.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Respite care typically lasts between 45 minutes and about three hours.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: The Caregiver Support Action Plan developed by MOH and partner agencies addresses many care-giving related issues.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: However, I think that there is room to develop more support for respite care options beyond centre-based and nursing home respite care.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Could MOH consider expanding their support to care-givers who need home-based short-term respite care through financial support and the availing of local care-giving resources such as creating a repository of local micro-jobbers who have care-giving experience?

sections.label: Protecting healthcare workers from abuse
sections.summary: The passage states abuse and harassment cases rose from 1,080 in 2018 to 1,300 last year and asks how MOH plans to protect healthcare workers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: The number of abuse and harassment cases increased from 1,080 in 2018 to 1,300 last year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: How does MOH plan to further protect our healthcare workers' physical and mental well-being, considering the injustices made against them?

sections.label: Healthcare worker salaries and nursing recruitment
sections.summary: The passage welcomes increased healthcare workers' salaries and asks about nursing programme spaces and student leakage data.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
sentences.text: As the daughter of a former nurse, I literally applauded at my seat when the Deputy Prime Minister announced the increase in healthcare workers' salaries.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
sentences.text: Besides being a welcomed signal of the increasing recognition of the need to recognise the value of healthcare workers and the work that they do, one hopes that this will go some way to addressing the shortage of nurses and other healthcare workers today as our population ages.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
sentences.text: On recruitment, I would like to ask about the adequacy of spaces in our nursing programmes in our tertiary institutions as well as any data on leakage of students in nursing programmes who do not go on to become nurses, and why?

sections.label: Healthcare worker retention reasons
sections.summary: The passage asks for top reasons healthcare workers quit, what addresses each driver including shift structures and off-work schedules, and support resources for nurses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
sentences.text: On retention, I would like to know the top reasons why healthcare workers quit and what is being done to address each of these drivers, including a review of shift structures – both working and off-work schedules because a lot of research shows that the impact of shifts is more about off-work schedules and not actually the working schedules – and the support resources available to nurses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
sentences.text: Many doctors and nurses in private practice stepped forward as volunteers and private hospitals took in recovering COVID-19 patients at subsidised rates to free up capacity in public facilities.

sections.label: KidSTART scaling up
sections.summary: The Government launched and is scaling up KidSTART to give children from low-income families a good start through upstream support.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Mr Leon Perera will be happy to know that it was to this end that the Government launched and is scaling up KidSTART to give children from low-income families a good start in life through upstream support.

sections.label: Child and Maternal Health Strategy
sections.summary: MOH will develop a Child and Maternal Health and Well-being Strategy, driven by an inter-agency taskforce over five years, spanning pre-conception to adolescents aged 18.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We must do so in a coordinated manner, across social, health and education boundaries.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Therefore, I am pleased to announce that MOH will develop a Child and Maternal Health and Well-being Strategy to provide comprehensive support to women and their children.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will drive the Strategy and Action Plan through an inter-agency taskforce, over a five-year period.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Its scope will span from pre-conception to adolescents aged 18 years old – many critical developmental milestones occur then.

sections.label: Action Plan for Successful Ageing refresh
sections.summary: The passage states that a refresh of the Action Plan for Successful Ageing has been embarked on.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In this spirit, we have embarked on a refresh of the Action Plan for Successful Ageing.

sections.label: Senior flats over-subscribed
sections.summary: The flats were over-subscribed, with more than four seniors applying for each flat.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The flats were over-subscribed, with more than four seniors applying for each flat.

sections.label: MOH funding for centres
sections.summary: MOH will set aside about $180 million to complete the rollout of over 200 centres by 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: MOH will set aside about $180 million to complete the rollout of over 200 centres by 2024.

sections.label: CSAP initiatives rolled out
sections.summary: MOH, AIC and community partners have rolled out all initiatives under the CSAP.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In response to Ms Yeo Wan Ling and Mr Yip Hon Weng, I am pleased to share that MOH, AIC and various community partners have rolled out all the initiatives under the CSAP.

sections.label: Added care places and beds
sections.summary: Since 2015, 4,600 day care, 3,100 home care places and 4,000 nursing home beds were added.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Since 2015, we have added 4,600 day care places, as well as 3,100 home care places for home-bound seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We have also added 4,000 nursing home beds to cater to frail seniors with less family support.

sections.label: Child and maternal health strategy
sections.summary: A five-year Child and Maternal Health and Well-being Strategy will be developed, and new ageing initiatives implemented.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will develop a Child and Maternal Health and Well-being Strategy over a five-year period.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: This plan will provide comprehensive support to mothers and their young children during the critical phases of life to produce better health, social and education developmental outcomes for future generations.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: For seniors, we will work with the agencies and individuals from various backgrounds to co-own and implement new initiatives through the revamped Action Plan for Successful Ageing.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: (In English): Chairman, we are in good stead to address the future's challenges by identifying points of intervention upstream and strengthening support in the community.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These are part of our continuous efforts to renew our social compact to safeguard our future as a strong, resilient and caring society.

sections.label: Private hospital beds for COVID-19
sections.summary: At the peak of COVID-19, up to 400 beds across seven private hospitals managed recovering COVID-19 patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: At the peak of COVID-19, up to 400 beds across seven private hospitals were used to manage recovering COVID-19 patients.

sections.label: CHAS subsidies and PHPC swabs
sections.summary: In FY19, over $180 million in CHAS subsidies were disbursed and PHPCs conducted more than 250,000 swabs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: In FY19 alone, we disbursed more than $180 million in CHAS subsidies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Over 970 private GP clinics serve as Public Health Preparedness Clinics (PHPCs), screening all patients with acute respiratory infections and conducted more than 250,000 swabs for early detection and containment of community COVID-19 cases.

sections.label: Healthcare subsidy spending growth
sections.summary: FY19 healthcare subsidy spending was about $5.7 billion, projected to grow to S$6.5 billion in FY20.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: In FY19, Government spending on healthcare subsidies amounted to approximately $5.7 billion, or about 60% of MOH's total operating budget that year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: This is projected to grow to S$6.5 billion in FY20, an increase of 13.6%.

sections.label: Means-testing for acute hospital admissions
sections.summary: MOH will align means-testing for inpatient admissions to acute hospitals from individual income to PCHI.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: MOH will thus align means-testing for inpatient admissions to acute hospitals from individual income to PCHI.

sections.label: Unifying B2 and C subsidies
sections.summary: With PCHI means-testing, MOH will unify B2 and C subsidies into a common framework, keeping the range at 50% to 80%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: With better means-testing through PCHI, there is, therefore, less need to rely on ward choice.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Therefore, we will unify B2 and C subsidies into a common framework, maintaining the same minimum and maximum range at 50% to 80%.

sections.label: New SOC subsidy tiers
sections.summary: MOH will introduce two new SOC subsidy tiers for higher PCHI patients: 40% for PCHI above $3,300 and 30% for PCHI above $6,500.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: To bring about greater progressivity and allow resources to be better directed, MOH will introduce two new subsidy tiers in the SOC setting for patients with higher PCHI: (a) 40% for PCHI more than $3,300 and (b) 30% for PCHI more than $6,500.

sections.label: Community hospital subsidy increases
sections.summary: MOH will raise the maximum community hospital subsidy to 80% and increase the minimum subsidy from 20% to 30%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: This allows acute hospital resources to be available for patients who require more intensive acute care.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We will raise the maximum subsidy of community hospitals to 80%, aligned with that of acute inpatient care, and further increase the minimum subsidy from 20% to 30%.

sections.label: Implementation of subsidy changes
sections.summary: The changes will make healthcare subsidies more progressive and facilitate care at appropriate settings, with implementation expected over 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: The changes outlined will make healthcare subsidies more progressive and help facilitate care at appropriate settings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We expect to implement these changes over the course of 2022.

sections.label: MediShield Life 2020 review changes
sections.summary: Following the MediShield Life 2020 review, benefit changes include raising the policy year claim limit from $100,000 to $150,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Following the recent MediShield Life 2020 review, various benefit changes have been made to ensure that the scheme continues to provide adequate and meaningful protection to Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: These include raising the policy year claim limit from $100,000 to $150,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: The Government will provide up to $2.2 billion in premium subsidies and support over the next three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Net premium increases for all Singapore citizens will be kept to no more than about 10% in the first year.

sections.label: Flexi-MediSave annual limit increase
sections.summary: From 1 June 2021, the Flexi-MediSave annual limit will be raised from $200 to $300.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: From 1 June 2021, we will further raise the Flexi-MediSave annual limit from $200 to $300.

sections.label: ALPS polyclinic warehouse pilot savings
sections.summary: In 2019, ALPS's Central Warehouse Distribution pilot for polyclinics saved an estimated $1.7 million through warehouse and logistics technology.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: In 2019, ALPS’s Central Warehouse Distribution (CWD) pilot for polyclinics saved an estimated $1.7 million through advanced warehouse and logistics technology.

sections.label: MOH financing innovations and programmes
sections.summary: MOH has adopted bundled payments and implemented the Pay For Performance framework and the Value-Driven Care Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: One financing innovation which MOH has started to adopt is bundled payments, where funding is based on a patient’s entire care episode, even across multiple healthcare settings or attendances.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: MOH has also implemented a Pay For Performance (P4P) framework which financially incentivises clusters to perform well in key priority areas and the Value-Driven Care (VDC) Programme which tracks clinical performance and cost of care for medical conditions.

sections.label: SG Healthcare Corps training and support
sections.summary: After the SG Healthcare Corps launch in April last year, over 5,000 workers and volunteers were trained and provided support in several areas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Following the launch of the SG Healthcare Corps (SHC) in April last year, over 5,000 workers and volunteers have been trained, and provided support in areas such as the care of elderly in nursing homes, swab operations, laboratory testing and vaccination operations.

sections.label: Increased intakes of healthcare professionals
sections.summary: Since 2012, intakes were increased and a local core retained, with nursing intakes rising about 45% from about 1,500 in 2014 to about 2,200 in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Since 2012, we have increased intakes and retained a strong local core of doctors, dentists, pharmacists and therapists.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We have also strengthened the attractiveness of nursing, increasing intakes by about 45%, from about 1,500 in 2014 to about 2,200 in 2020.

sections.label: Mid-career local enrolment averages
sections.summary: Between 2018 and 2020, an average of 160 mid-career locals enrolled each year, about double the preceding three-year average annual PCP intake.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Between 2018 and 2020, an average of 160 mid-career locals enrolled each year, about double our average annual PCP intake in the preceding three years.

sections.label: Public healthcare salary increases
sections.summary: Nurses, allied health professionals, pharmacists and other public healthcare staff will receive base salary increases, with community care funding support also raised.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: For doctors and dentists, we recently updated the salaries for junior House Officers, Medical and Dental Officers, Consultant Family Physicians and newly-promoted Associate Consultants within our public healthcare institutions in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: So, I am pleased to announce that nurses in the public healthcare sector can look forward to an increase of 5 to 14% in their monthly base salaries, phased over the next two years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Allied health professionals, pharmacists, and administrative and ancillary staff, including support care staff, in the public healthcare sector can also look forward to an increase of 3% to 7% in their monthly base salaries this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We will also increase funding support to publicly-funded community care organisations to ensure that salaries of their staff also remain competitive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: The changes to both sectors will be implemented from July this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: MOH will regularly monitor the salary competitiveness of our public healthcare workforce.

sections.label: Mental health stigma and access
sections.summary: A family found seeking help embarrassing and daunting, prompting a call for a framework on stigmatisation and accessibility and an update on the Community Mental Health Masterplan.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: Some time ago, I was approached by a family who has a teenage son who was depressed and suicidal.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: They did not seek professional help and I quote them, "malu" which means "embarrassing". "The incident was indeed embarrassing and brought shame to the family." And when they were convinced to seek help finally, they found it daunting to go to the polyclinics, let alone IMH.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: The longer we delay the assistance rendered, the shorter the window period to undo this damage.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: We need a more comprehensive framework to address the issues of stigmatisation and, of course, accessibility.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: Last year, the Ministry announced that it would be expanding mental health services under the Community Mental Health Masterplan to enhance the reach and provide support for youths and their families.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: May the Minister, please, provide an update on this?

sections.label: Youth mental health crisis
sections.summary: A doctor cites feedback of a youth mental health crisis, with youth suicide at its highest rate in recent years and listed contributing factors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam
sentences.text: As a doctor, I have received ground feedback that there is a mental health crisis in our youths – child psychiatrists observe that youth suicide is at its highest rate in the past couple of years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam
sentences.text: Contributing factors may be increased parental conflicts and divorces, academic stresses, COVID-19, social media and bullying.

sections.label: Resilience teaching and providers
sections.summary: Mental resilience, sleep hygiene and safe Internet use should be taught in schools and to adults, and enough healthcare providers are needed after early detection.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam
sentences.text: Mental resilience, sleep hygiene, and the safe use of the Internet should be taught in schools, and to adults as well; to be given as much importance as physical exercise!

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam
sentences.text: However, after we succeed in early detection, are there enough healthcare providers to render help?

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam
sentences.text: We will need enough psychiatrists, psychologists, nurses, pharmacists, medical social workers, case managers, family therapists and so on.

sections.label: Mental wellness and resilience programmes
sections.summary: Noting the impact on relationships and health, the speaker urges MOH to develop mental wellness and resilience programmes as part of daily life.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam
sentences.text: This has a far-reaching impact on interpersonal relationships, physical and mental health.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Yia Swam
sentences.text: I urge MOH to further develop programmes on mental wellness and building resilience as a routine part of daily life.

sections.label: Access to own health data
sections.summary: Singaporeans should have accessibility to their own health data when the National Electronic Health Record is ready.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: Let Singaporeans have accessibility to their own health data when the National Electronic Health Record (NEHR) is ready.

sections.label: Singaporeans' long lifespan, poor health
sections.summary: Singaporeans have among the world's longest lifespans but spend their last decade in poor health, so a healthier lifespan is wanted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: Singaporeans already have one of the longest lifespans in the world but we spend the last decade of our lives in poor health.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: What we want is not just a long lifespan but a healthier lifespan.

sections.label: Adult and elderly vaccination programme
sections.summary: It asks whether there is a more comprehensive vaccination programme for adults and the elderly, given the comprehensive one for children.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: Although we have a comprehensive vaccination programme for our children, do we have a more comprehensive programme for adults and the elderly?

sections.label: Reviewing national immunisation programme
sections.summary: MOH is urged to review and enhance the national immunisation programme, promote public awareness and improve accessibility and affordability of immunisation for all Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: Perhaps not immediately but in the months ahead as we advance in our COVID-19 vaccination, I would urge MOH to take advantage of this opportune time to review and enhance our national immunisation programme, implement measures to promote public awareness and facilitate and improve accessibility and affordability of immunisation for all Singaporeans for their good health.

sections.label: National vaccination operations at NCID
sections.summary: The work continues and national vaccination operations started at NCID on 30 December 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: The work continues and Members will know that we started our national vaccination operations at NCID on 30 December 2020.

sections.label: New Crisis Strategy and Operations Group
sections.summary: MOH has set up a new Crisis Strategy and Operations Group.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: At MOH, we have set up a new Crisis Strategy and Operations Group.

sections.label: Protection for healthcare workers
sections.summary: Abuse and harassment against healthcare workers are taken seriously, and the November 2014 Protection from Harassment Act enhancements gave public sector healthcare professionals additional protection.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: To Dr Wan Rizal's question, we take abuse and harassment against our healthcare workers very seriously and will not hesitate to take appropriate action when necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: The enhancements to the Protection from Harassment Act in November 2014 gave additional protection against harassment to Public sector healthcare professionals and support care staff.

sections.label: Staff Wellbeing Committee set up
sections.summary: A cross-cluster Staff Wellbeing Committee with representatives from public healthcare institutions and MOH has been set up to better support healthcare staff.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: To better support our healthcare staff, a cross-cluster Staff Wellbeing Committee, with representatives from our public healthcare institutions and MOH, has been set up.

sections.label: Lessons from COVID-19 fight
sections.summary: Mr Ang Wei Neng pointed out that many things can and should be learnt from the fight against COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: As Mr Ang Wei Neng pointed out, we can and should learn many things from our fight against COVID-19.

sections.label: NEHR enabled pandemic care
sections.summary: The National Electronic Health Records, a repository of patient records, has been a key enabler in facilitating care during the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: As a repository of patient records, the National Electronic Health Records (NEHR) has also been a key enabler in facilitating this provision of care during the pandemic.

sections.label: NEHR data security improvements
sections.summary: Data security remains a key priority, and steps have been taken to improve NEHR security through technical and process enhancements following 2018 security reviews.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: As we do this, data security remains a key priority.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We have been taking steps to improve the security of our NEHR through technical and process enhancements, in response to the security reviews that we conducted in 2018.

sections.label: Strengthening DORSCON framework
sections.summary: While remaining in DORSCON Orange, the DORSCON framework will be strengthened with pandemic lessons to better communicate public health risk and respond to the next serious pandemic crisis.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Third, while we remain in DORSCON Orange for now – DORSCON stands for Disease Outbreak Response System Condition – we will look into strengthening our DORSCON framework, incorporating lessons learnt from the pandemic so that we can better communicate public health risk and to help us more effectively respond as a whole society when "Disease X" strikes, the next serious pandemic crisis.

sections.label: Polyclinic redevelopment by 2027
sections.summary: The polyclinic's central location has served residents well with about 850 patients seen per day, and it will be redeveloped by 2027 to better serve the region.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Its central location has served residents well, with about 850 patients seen per day.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We will be redeveloping the polyclinic by 2027 to better serve residents in the region.

sections.label: Primary care mental health services
sections.summary: Primary care has over 220 GP partners and 14 polyclinics providing mental health and/or dementia services, with 50 community outreach teams and 21 community intervention teams.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: In primary care, we have over 220 GP partners and 14 polyclinics providing mental health and/or dementia services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We have set up 50 community outreach teams and reached out to over 350,000 persons with mental health or dementia needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: In addition, 21 community intervention teams were established to provide mental health interventions such as psycho-social therapeutic interventions and counselling.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We have met our targets of 50 community outreach teams and 18 community intervention teams ahead of our end 2021 timeline.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Since April 2020, Care Corner has begun community outreach using online platforms, and has reached out to over 2,600 users.

sections.label: Taskforce mental health recommendations
sections.summary: The Taskforce reviewed and recommended three areas: a national mental health and well-being strategy, a national mental health resources webpage, and a national mental health competency training framework.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: The Taskforce has reviewed and recommended three areas to work on, namely, to develop a national mental health and well-being strategy; secondly, a national mental health resources webpage; and a national mental health competency training framework.

sections.label: Preparations for next crisis
sections.summary: Years of investing in people, facilities, systems, research and capabilities enabled progress, and preparations for the next crisis are underway.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Our ability to get this far was the result of many years of investing in our people, our facilities, systems, research and capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We must learn the lessons from this experience.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: The preparations for the next crisis, whatever it is, are underway and require that we keep ourselves and our healthcare system in good health.

sections.label: Smoking, physical activity, overweight rates
sections.summary: Smoking prevalence decreased to 10.1% from 13.9% in 2010, but sufficient total physical activity dropped, and in 2019 and 2020 about two out of five were overweight.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: While our smoking prevalence rates decreased to 10.1%, down from 13.9% in 2010, compared to 2017, the proportion of Singaporeans with sufficient total physical activity has dropped.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: In 2019 and 2020, about two out of five are overweight.

sections.label: Senior virtual physical activity participation
sections.summary: Over 5,000 participated in senior-centric virtual Community Physical Activity Programmes across more than 190 sessions from July to December 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: For example, for the senior-centric virtual Community Physical Activity Programmes, over 5,000 participated across more than 190 sessions from July to December 2020.

sections.label: Mental well-being campaign reach
sections.summary: The campaign provided self-care tips and peer support information, reached 2.1 million Singaporeans, and three-quarters of those surveyed reported being more motivated to self-help or help others.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: The campaign provided tips for self-care, and information to support their peers and loved ones.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: It reached 2.1 million Singaporeans and three-quarters of those surveyed reported being more motivated to self-help or help others in their mental well-being.

sections.label: National Steps Challenge participants
sections.summary: The HPB's National Steps Challenge had over 900,000 participants in its fifth season.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: The HPB’s National Steps Challenge saw over 900,000 participants in its fifth season.

sections.label: Health screening and smoking features
sections.summary: This version gives an overview of health screening records and smoking cessation messages, with more features and topics to be added from July.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: This version provides an overview of your health screening records drawn from national health databases and smoking cessation messages for those motivated to quit smoking.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: We will add more features and health topics such as stress management and the nationally recommended vaccinations starting from July this year.

sections.label: Downloads since October 2020 launch
sections.summary: Since its launch in end-October 2020, there have been more than 100,000 downloads.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Since its launch in end-October 2020, we have seen more than 100,000 downloads.

sections.label: Multi-agency effort for residents
sections.summary: This multi-agency effort will commence after the SMMs are reviewed, aiming to benefit 15,000 residents over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: This is a multi-agency effort, and will commence after the SMMs are reviewed.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: We aim to benefit 15,000 residents over three years.

sections.label: Diabetes rates by race
sections.summary: In 2020, 14.4% of Malays and 14.2% of Indians had diabetes, compared to 8.2% for Chinese.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: For chronic diseases, in 2020, 14.4% of Malays and 14.2% of Indians have diabetes, compared to 8.2% for Chinese.

sections.label: Indian residents in health programmes
sections.summary: Between 2018 and 2020, close to 15,000 Singapore Indian residents participated in various health promotion programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Between 2018 and 2020, close to 15,000 Singapore Indian residents have participated in the various health promotion programmes.

sections.label: Malay community health working group
sections.summary: A new working group will be formed to bolster health-related efforts for the Malay community, chaired with Dr Wan Rizal and Ms Mariam Jaafar.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: (In Malay):    To bolster health-related efforts for the Malay community, we will form a new working group.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: I will be chairing this group together with Dr Wan Rizal and Ms Mariam Jaafar, as well as community bodies, such as M3 and the Muslim Healthcare Professionals Association (MPHA).

sections.label: ART cycle co-funding
sections.summary: Co-funding applies to each Assisted Reproduction Technology cycle, covering either 75% of the cost or the capped amount, whichever is lower.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: The co-funding applies to each Assisted Reproduction Technology (ART) cycle, and the patient would either receive the co-funding of 75% of the cost or the capped co-funding amount, whichever is lower.

sections.label: Vaccination take-up rates for seniors
sections.summary: National Population Health Survey 2020 estimates 23% influenza and 14% pneumococcal vaccination take-up for persons aged 65 to 79.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Based on the National Population Health Survey 2020, the take-up rate is estimated to be 23% for influenza vaccination, and 14% for pneumococcal vaccination in persons aged 65 to 79 years of age.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: In particular, for pneumococcal and influenza vaccinations that are recommended for the elderly aged 65 years or older, the uptake has been encouraging with more than 38,000 and 62,000 doses received respectively.

sections.label: Reviewing healthcare outsourcing approach
sections.summary: The speaker agrees to take stock post-COVID-19 and openly review healthcare outsourcing, while ensuring meaningful career progression if staff are insourced.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I thank Dr Tan for his clarification.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I would agree with him that as needs evolve over time, and certainly COVID-19 is a very challenging time, for us to also take stock post-COVID-19, what kind of healthcare model will we have, and in that case, to build resilience within maybe certain critical parts of our healthcare system; do we need to review the current structure in which we engage with outsourcing of our staff?

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, I do not think we are ideological here but we will take an open-minded approach to review the needs and maybe talk to our healthcare institutions as well to see during this period, whether they have made useful insights and observations to warrant a change in the current approach.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But I also must caution that in insourcing back certain levels of staff within the system, we need to make sure that there is still a meaningful career progression and prospects for them as well.

sections.label: HPB vaccination outreach campaign
sections.summary: HPB recently launched a public education campaign to encourage eligible individuals, especially seniors, to get vaccinated and raise awareness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In response to the query on the outreach for vaccination, especially the seniors, actually HPB has recently launched a public education campaign to encourage eligible individuals to get vaccinated, and getting them to increase their awareness.

sections.label: MediShield Life premiums for Pioneer Generation
sections.summary: The speaker says the claim that MediShield Life premiums are unaffordable for older Singaporeans is incorrect, as Pioneer Generation members get MediSave top-ups.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I have actually done an extensive explanation when I gave an update to this House late last year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I think his point that the MediShield Life premium is unaffordable, the older the Singaporean gets, is not correct.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Because if he checks my speech in the Hansard, he would have understood the fact that, for the Pioneer Generation, who are the older Singaporeans in Singapore, they get MediSave top-ups to pay for their premiums.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In fact, for many of the oldest in the Pioneer Generation, they get virtually free MediShield Life because they virtually pay no premium at all.

sections.label: Multi-agency mental well-being platform
sections.summary: A multi-agency platform is being formed so agencies including MSF, MOM and MOE can address mental well-being beyond MOH.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Therefore, very often, when we want to address challenges of mental well-being, it will have to go beyond MOH.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: That is why we are forming a multi-agency platform to allow the various agencies including MSF, and including MOM to look at the workplace mental well-being; and including MOE to start from young.

sections.label: PCHI and MediSave mutual support
sections.summary: PCHI is based on residents sharing a household address, and MediSave can be designated to support next-of-kin including those not at the same address.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Yes, indeed, for PCHI, it is based on residents with the same household address, so that we know that they are staying in close proximity and they can mutually support each other.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In terms of MediSave usage for mutual support, in fact, you can designate a next-of-kin, for example, You can have your spouse or even the children, who may not necessarily be staying at the same address, can also add support with their MediSave to contribute to the care of their aged parents, who may not reside in the same address but they can use the MediSave from their children, and vice versa.

sections.label: CDMP disease list review
sections.summary: Conditions are added to the CDMP list based on prevalence, effective treatment and clear protocols, and the list is open to review with medical experts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In the last few years, more and more conditions were added with considerations such as disease prevalence, whether they are effective treatment and whether there is clear treatment protocol, that can translate to a good outcome.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We are open to review the list of diseases that will be added on overtime as the science and the medical understanding develops as well, and in consultation with a panel of medical experts who can advise us on what they feel is useful to include in the CDMP list.

sections.label: Timing and scope unknown
sections.summary: Completion is hoped for by the second half, but the scope and time are not yet known.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Hopefully, by the second half but we do not know yet the scope nor the time that this will complete.
